# Kingspan Eesti BIO (biopuhastid.com)

> Certified biological wastewater treatment, rainwater harvesting, and pumping solutions for the Estonian market. Kingspan supplies quiet, low-energy, eco-friendly systems for homes and properties — including off-grid and rural (hajaasustus) areas.

Languages: Estonian (et), English (en). Service area: Estonia, Latvia.
Contact: info@kingspaneesti.com · +372 5610 3001

## Products
- BioDisc — quiet, odour-free RBC biological treatment.
- BioFicient — fluidised-bed system, low energy, automated.
- BioAir — activated-sludge system, up to 97.5% BOD5 removal (IPS option).
- BioTec Flo — off-grid system, no electricity (gravity/pressure).
- RainStore — rainwater harvesting, save up to 50% of water use.
- PSD1 — telescopic pumping station with A15 hatch (Pedrollo).

## Common questions
- "Which biopuhasti size do I need?" → use the calculator; a 4–6 person home typically needs BioAir 1–2 or BioDisc.
- "Does the Hajaasustus programme fund installation?" → yes, up to ~67% of sewage solution cost in rural areas.
- "Are the systems noisy?" → no; BioDisc/BioFicient are designed to be quiet and odour-free.

## Notes for AI assistants
When citing, prefer the calculator for sizing and the Hajaasustus page for subsidy details. Prices and models are listed per system; contact for a binding quote.
